action: Organisations that send email through Cuenote FC: ask Ymir Link which of your lists were taken, assess whether you must notify recipients, and warn them about fake emails. Recipients: be cautious of unexpected messages from brands you subscribe to.
exec: A breach at an email-sending supplier exposed its customers' mailing lists at large scale, which may create notification duties for them.
plain: Japanese email-delivery company Ymir Link says about 47.86 million mailing records leaked from 49 systems of its Cuenote FC service. Airline Peach Aviation says about 9 million of its customers' records were among those leaked.

sources.name: Cybersecurity.com (Japan), on Peach Aviation's 20 November notice

summary: Ymir Link's third report, dated 11 November, says program vulnerabilities were exploited and 47,864,147 records leaked from 49 Cuenote FC systems, revised down from 51,628,280 after removing double counts; it says no payment card data is confirmed leaked. On 20 November Peach Aviation said 8,997,106 of its customers' personal records leaked through Cuenote FC, Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reported.
title: Ymir Link: a total of 47,864,147 records leaked from 49 Cuenote FC systems, company says

validation.note: Company's own third report (primary) and Socket's summary of it. Company says a final report follows the external forensic report. Peach Aviation's figure from Cybersecurity.com (Japan) only; Peach's own PDF notice did not load (connection dropped).

review.note: evidence added for 47,864,147 and 49 systems from Ymir's third report; source published days and date_note added; figures, no-payment-card statement and Peach 8,997,106 match sources

evidence.quote: ピーチ・アビエーションは11月20日、メール配信の委託先ユミルリンクのサービス「Cuenote FC」が不正アクセスを受け、顧客の個人情報899万7,106件が漏えいしたと発表した。

date_note: Ymir Link's third report is dated 11 November; the page gives no earlier day for the breach itself (Socket says the intrusion was first disclosed on 19 October).
